description: Clan Primer Traveler's Tips: a Proficiency tip (17th entry, The Ways of Strength) that appears while menu-info flag bit `flag` (0-254; 0xFF means no flag test) is set; the Proficiency runtime sets it while the Apprentice's Writ is owned.

tip.title: Clan Proficiency
tip.body:
Clan Centurio trains its members in the ways of their
jobs. Each time you rise in the clan's ranks, Montblanc
has something for you as you leave the clan hall: a
Writ, or a fresh stamp on the one you carry.

While the Writ is in your Key Items, every character
fights with the Proficiency of the job they hold. Their
weapons and armour gain that job's edge, whatever they
wield.

The Apprentice's Writ opens Proficiency I. The
Journeyman's and Master's Writs open II and III. Change
jobs freely: the clan's training goes with you.
